Remove the sources of corruption that still taint the Forge and purify its fires once more to obtain a [[Obsidian armor|reward]] worthy of heroes.

==Quest Information==
===Objectives===
* Destroy the [[Seed of Corruption|Seeds of Corruption]]. '''5..0''' Seeds of Corruption remain.
* Return to [[Eternal Forgemaster]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]

==Walkthrough==
The Seeds of Corruption all spawn in a cave to the south known as the [[Spider Cave]]. Each of the Seeds spawn next to one of the [[Doubter's Dryder]]s and its associated pop-ups of [[Armored Cave Spider]]s that are normally in the cave. The quest is complete when the last Seed is dead.  Parties with bonders should beware as both the Dryders are heavy on enchantment removal.

It is possible to clear the cave of dryders and spiders before taking the quest.

==NPCs==
===Foes===
[[Plant]]s
*{{n}} 24 (26) [[Seed of Corruption]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial Dialogue===
;Eternal Forgemaster
:''"Here at the heart of the [[Temple of War]] are forged the very arms and armor of the gods. This most sacred of places has been defiled. During the brief period while the vile Shadow Army of Menzies usurped the Temple, they choked the pure fires of the forge with a vile miasma used to imbue all their weapons with an unholy taint.''
:''"Though they have been driven from the Temple, the source of the corruption remains in the tunnel that feeds the forge. Go to the tunnel and purge it of all '''seeds of corruption'''."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I'm on my way.
|decline = I do not have time for this now.
| ask = I would not consider using the forge in this condition. Anything created while the fires are so corrupted will surely be corrupt itself. Seek out the source of this taint. Hunt down the '''seeds of corruption''' left by [[Menzies]].
}}

===Reward Dialogue===
;Eternal Forgemaster
:''"I shall bear witness of your deeds to [[Balthazar]]. The fires burn pure once more. Perhaps now I can resume my work."''

==Notes==
* This is the final quest required for players to craft [[Obsidian armor]]
* Completing this quest also allows you to sell items to the [[Eternal Forgemaster]].

==Trivia==
*This quest was added in the [[Game updates/20050511|May 11, 2005]] update.
